scope: Read-only research. No production data or code was changed.

rootCause.summary: Duplicates are created because fighter identity is the Tapology slug or, when the URL is missing, classKey-slugify(name). resolvePoolId only adopts an existing row by exact id, exact canonical URL, or exact normalized name when that row has NO tapologyUrl. A slug-only URL and a numeric URL are treated as different people, and a null-URL AFR/card row cannot attach to an existing slug-URL row. upsertFighterPool therefore inserts a second id. Fighters missing from fightersByClass are not deactivated, so the old row remains. syncUpcomingCardFighters then matches by normalizeFighterName and .find()s the first hit; if that hit is the old inactive row, it gets reactivated, and both copies end up active. The Nov 10 cards import is the smoking gun: reactivatedFromCards listed Samuel Sanches, Alik Lorenz, Modestino Rodrigues, Akbar Abdullaev, Mehemmedeli Osmanli, Quentin Pasley, and Roberto Soldic — exactly seven of the eight both-active pairs Olin reported (Juan Díaz was already a double-active AFR self-duplicate and was not in that list). AFR itself currently lists both 'Juan Diaz' (null URL) and 'Juan Díaz' (slug URL), and both 'Jeong Yeong Lee' and 'Lee Jeong-yeong'. slugify also fails to transliterate ł, which is why Mary's drafted Jan Błachowicz is stuck on id jan-b-achowicz while AFR created jan-blachowicz.
suggestedFix: In resolvePoolId, match by normalizeFighterName even when the existing row already has a Tapology URL, and treat numeric vs slug-only URLs as the same fighter (compare the trailing name slug, not only the full canonical URL).

Deduplicate the incoming AFR fightersByClass list by normalized name (and token-sort / family-name-first variants) before upsert, so Juan Diaz / Juan Díaz and Jeong Yeong Lee / Lee Jeong-yeong cannot both be inserted.
When matchFighterByName has more than one exact normalized-name hit, prefer a rostered or already-active row and never reactivate a second copy.
When adopting, copy the better (numeric) Tapology URL onto the kept id; never mint classKey-slugify(name) if a normalized-name match exists.
Transliterate crossed letters in slugify (ł→l, đ→d, ø→o) so Jan Błachowicz cannot get a second id jan-b-achowicz.
Add a searchable alias / display-name field so Tina Black, Ozzy Diaz, Chapolin, Bia Mesquita, and Tommy Gantt are findable under the names players actually type.
